label: Built
title: The local signer foundation.
description: Implemented in the current 0.9.0 codebase. The signing, identity, and permission controls at the heart of Ostrilo.

items.title: Sign in and sign events
items.body: NIP-07 getPublicKey and signEvent, background signing, public-key consent, request validation, and a managed approval queue.

items.title: Manage multiple identities
items.body: Create and import keys, rename them, switch your active identity, and delete with password re-verification. Private keys are encrypted locally.

items.title: Control site permissions
items.body: Per-site trust, event-kind rules, session grants, and protected kinds that always require approval. Signing and disclosure decisions appear in Activity.

items.title: Lock, recover, and manage profiles
items.body: Manual and automatic locking, master-password changes, an encrypted first-key onboarding backup, profile editing, and configurable relays.

items.title: Check the build and signing journeys
items.body: Coverage gates, security tests, Chromium browser tests, Chrome and Firefox builds, bundle checks, dependency audits, and secret scanning.

label: Next
title: Make the foundation dependable.
description: The next steps in recovery, signing clarity, and verification from the source roadmap.

items.title: A recovery path for every key
items.body: Backup and export for keys added after onboarding, restore outside onboarding, and clearer import/export options. Make it easier to keep every identity portable.

items.title: Independent security review
items.body: Review the vault, signing path, and RPC privilege boundary. Publish the findings. A planned milestone on the path to 1.0.

items.title: Further hardening and verification
items.body: Finish sensitive-input isolation and erasure coverage, meter requests that auto-sign, expand accessibility auditing, and work toward reproducible-build checks.

items.title: Better approvals and activity
items.body: Parsed event previews and risk information. Improve activity export and filtering, then add search, date ranges, and CSV export.

items.title: A clearer developer surface
items.body: Consistent page-facing errors, accurate API documentation, formal TypeScript definitions, capability detection, and versioning guidance.

label: Later
title: Broader Nostr support, deliberately.
description: Planned or exploratory work. These are directions, with no promised dates or release numbers.

items.title: More protocol depth
items.body: NIP-44 encryption, NIP-42 authentication, NIP-57 validation, NIP-65 relay lists, and NIP-05 verification.

items.title: Portable encrypted keys and remote signing
items.body: NIP-49 ncryptsec import, broader standard export formats, and NIP-46 remote signing are roadmap work.

items.title: Multi-device and advanced key protection
items.body: Authenticated sync, encrypted device transfer, optional seed recovery, and hardware-backed or biometric options are longer-term directions.
